question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word in the given sentence to fill in the blank.

The manager is so **stingy** that he never appreciates the efforts of the teammates but the chairperson is really very ____________ in this matter.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Generous)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stingy"** refers to being unwilling to spend or share money or resources, often to an excessive degree. (कंजूस)

 
 
• **Example:** The **stingy **landlord refused to fix the broken heater despite repeated requests.
 
 
 
• **"Generous"** refers to someone who is willing to give or share freely, often more than expected or necessary. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a **generous **donor who supports multiple charities.
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the manager is "stingy" and does not appreciate the teammates. The opposite of "stingy" is "generous," which fits the sentence perfectly.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Generous)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aggressive** (आक्रामक): Ready or likely to attack or confront; characterized by boldness or forcefulness.

 
 
• **Example:** The player was too aggressive and received a penalty for his actions.
 
 
 
• **Strict** (सख्त): Demanding that rules or standards are obeyed and observed.
 
 
• **Example:** The strict teacher ensured that all homework was submitted on time.
 
 
 
• **Lazy** (आलसी): Unwilling to work or use energy.
 
 
• **Example:** He is too lazy to clean his own room.
